title: Private tenant assertion gatekeeper & role-reconciliation urgent remediation
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Summary: Multiple enterprise Private customers reported short windows where newly-joined service requests were authorized with an overly permissive RBAC binding and corresponding audit events were not present in the control-plane logs. Impact affects tenant onboarding and SAML-based SSO flows on Private clusters that also use on-prem KMS envelopes.

Observed behavior: During tenant onboarding the SAML assertion processing pipeline sometimes proceeds before the tenant key rewrap/unwrap handshake completes, causing a fallback code path that attaches a transient permissive role-binding for continuity. Simultaneously, the local audit-uploader batcher experienced a transient 503 from the control-plane ingest endpoint and dropped a small buffer of recent events (buffer not yet flushed to durable store). Combined, this produced: brief window of over-permissive access (seconds) + missing audit trail for those requests.

Root cause (summary): 1) race between assertion-to-role mapping and KMS envelope availability when tenant key metadata is being rehydrated; 2) non-idempotent audit buffer drop on transient ingest failure (uploader did not persist failed batch to durable staging and retry idempotently).

Impact: Several customers escalated (support cases #C-9342, #C-9411) citing compliance violation risk. No evidence of data exfiltration; observed accesses were limited to ephemeral metadata reads. Still classified as security-sensitive and regulatory-impacting.

Acceptance criteria / definition of done: - Prevent assertion processing from attaching permissive fallback role during KMS rewrap window. - Ensure audit events are durably queued and retried; implement backfill path to reconstruct missing events for affected time windows. - Ship emergency patch with a canary rollout to Private space and an automated post-deploy reconciliation job. - Provide customer-facing incident notes and reconciliation artifacts for affected tenants.
updates: 2026-03-10: Pager: Oncall received multiple escalations from Enterprise customers in EU region during tenant onboarding. Triage: blocked reproduction in staging; reproduced in a Private dev cluster using simulated delayed KMS unwrap. Initial mitigation: applied temporary rate-limit to the assertion conveyor to slow processing (manual throttle).

2026-03-11: Root cause analysis completed: identified assertion pipeline does not check 'tenant_key_state==READY' before applying role bindings. Audit-uploader dropped buffered batch on 503 without writing to disk. Created design doc for gating and durable buffer (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/PCS/ENG-315208).

2026-03-12: Patch designed: (a) gate SAML/assertion processing on explicit 'key_ready' signal emitted by key-rewrap handler, with a short optimistic backoff to avoid adding high-latency path; (b) make audit-uploader write pending batches to local encrypted staging (S3 for hosted, local FS for Private) and idempotent-retry with deterministic batch IDs; (c) reconciliation worker to reconstruct missing events from staging buffers and tenant-proxy logs and push to audit store. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/1219

2026-03-13: Security review: asked SEC team for expedited review of gating logic and staging storage encryption. SEC feedback: require HSM-wrapped metadata pointer in staging and a short TTL for staged batches (encrypt with tenant KMS). Implemented encryption wrapper and TTL enforcement.

2026-03-14: Canary rollout plan approved by SRE and PM. Canary targets: two Private customers with low-risk staging clusters, 15-minute observation window with strict SLO guardrails. Reconciliation script prepared to backfill last 2 hours of events for affected tenants. Customer comms draft posted to support drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/incident/ENG-315208/notes

Next steps: Merge PR, deploy canary to Private cluster region eu-west-1, monitor for role-binding regressions and audit ingest success. If stable after canary, promote to all Private clusters and run reconciliation job for impacted tenants. Update customers with signed-off backfill artifacts.
